title: Parents and Offspring
seo_title: Grade 1 Parents and Offspring Worksheets: How Animal Parents Help Their Babies
standard_text: Read texts and use media to determine patterns in behavior of parents and offspring that help offspring survive.
meta_desc: Free grade 1 science worksheets on parents and offspring (NGSS 1-LS1-2): how animal parents feed, protect and teach their young, and how babies ask for help. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Parents feed and protect. Babies cry or chirp for help.
body_html:
How to think about it

Parents help their babies live.

  • Parents feed, carry, protect and teach.
  • Babies cry and chirp to ask for help.
  • Some animals, like sea turtles, leave their eggs.
Example

A mother bird brings worms. How does it help?

Babies need food.

Answer: The chick gets food.

Example

A baby cries. Why?

It needs help.

Answer: It tells the parent it needs something.

Common mistakes

  • Thinking babies cry for no reason.
  • Thinking all animal parents stay with their babies.
  • Thinking baby birds can find food right away.

faq.q: How do animal parents help their babies?
faq.a: They feed them, keep them warm, carry and protect them, and teach them to find food.

faq.q: Why do babies cry or chirp?
faq.a: To tell parents they are hungry, cold, lost or need help.

faq.q: Do all animal parents take care of their babies?
faq.a: No. Sea turtles, many fish and frogs lay eggs and leave. They lay many eggs, so some babies survive.
